notes: CORRECTED 2026-07-04: earlier pass called this canonical solely because it carries a source citation at this node. Re-designated DUPLICATE: its descendant Simon Swanson variant (I182195860381, via child I182195860594) has only a generic 'Ancestry Family Trees' marriage source and a child list that doesn't match the externally-verified lineage, whereas the parallel branch (I182382755763 -> I182292318217 -> I182197442974) connects to Simon Swanson's real, multiply-sourced MA marriage record and his three children exactly as documented in gen05-simon-swanson-anna-josephina-svenson.md. Canonical: I182382755763.

MISSING PARENTS (not applicable now that this is the duplicate): the other copy I182382755763 lists parents Jakob Kristoffersson (I182391485866) and Annika Torbjörnsdotter (I182391485891); this record's own parents field is empty.

Same tree-duplication pattern as the John Albertson & Ann Pine case (gen 6, see direct-line-issues.md): the whole Samuel Jacobsson/Sofia Nilsdotter/Gustava Samuelsdotter/Sven Johan Samuelsson nuclear-family group exists twice in parallel, apparently from two merged tree imports. See docs/research/ancestors/gen07-samuel-jacobsson.md for the full writeup.
